summary: End-to-end verification of the new /console Admin dashboard (backend + frontend + role isolation). 21/21 pytest backend tests pass against the live public URL. Frontend flows verified via Playwright: Super Admin lands on /console with real Overview stats (all 6 stat cards sourced from GET /api/admin/overview — no mocked data), Managers tab creates/funds/quota-updates managers (row count 28 -> 29 after Add Manager), Admins tab renders admins-table, Transactions tab shows paginated ledger with type filter + reverse modal, API Keys panel renders. Manager view exposes only nav-my-admins/nav-my-transactions (no nav-managers). Admin view exposes nav-my-players only. Player login redirects to / and direct visit to /console also redirects to / (guard works).

issues: Testid naming mismatch vs review request: implementation uses stat-circulation/stat-allocated/stat-remaining while the request spec calls them stat-coins-in-circulation/stat-coins-allocated/stat-coins-remaining. Both render real values from GET /api/admin/overview — this is a docs/spec drift, not a functional bug. Consider aligning to the spec names OR updating the spec to match code.

action_items: (Optional) Align OverviewPanel stat testids to the spec: rename stat-circulation -> stat-coins-in-circulation, stat-allocated -> stat-coins-allocated, stat-remaining -> stat-coins-remaining. Or update the review spec/docs to reflect the current shorter names.

(Testing tip) Playwright force=True clicks on the console sidebar buttons sometimes fail to trigger the React onClick (likely because a toast overlay swallows the synthetic event). Use non-force clicks on nav-<tab> buttons — that works reliably.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py /admin/admins returns 'remaining' equal to wallet_balance — technically correct today because Admins only receive via MANAGER_TO_ADMIN and spend via ADMIN_GRANT so wallet==remaining, but semantically confusing. Consider computing remaining explicitly as allocated - used to make intent obvious even if values coincide.
admin.py /admin/allocate has good atomic quota reservation with rollback on InsufficientFunds — no double-spend hazard found in tests.

admin.py /admin/transactions per-row iterates users/player_assignments/admin_allocations with only an in-memory user_cache; assignment/allocation lookups still hit DB per row. Fine at limit<=200, but consider caching by admin_id if this endpoint gets hot.
OverviewPanel loads all metrics in a single /admin/overview call — good. No fabricated data, honest 'coming soon' placeholders for DAU/alerts/time-series.
Role guards: Manager/Admin correctly get 403 on /admin/overview, /admin/managers, /admin/admins, /admin/transactions (parametrized test passes). Player also 403 on /admin/overview.
ConsolePage guards player redirect via AuthRoute/CONSOLE_ROLES — verified: player1 direct visit to /console lands on /.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Console is fully wired. Backend endpoints under /api/admin/* return real DB numbers. Frontend testids in Overview differ slightly from the spec (see design_issues). When writing Playwright, avoid force=True on nav-<tab> buttons — a toast overlay from prior actions intercepts synthetic clicks; use a normal click on the button directly. Login should press Enter in auth-password-input (submit button is also intercepted by toast). Manager1 (seed) may have low available_quota after this run; top it up via /admin/managers/{id}/quota and /admin/managers/{id}/fund before running allocate tests.
